census.note: Every direct E8 call site of 0x6099ce0 (callers.tsv, with enclosing FDE). Matches #3257 exactly. Three sites were pinned by #3257 (BlockTableOptions, SkipListFactoryOptions, empty-key); the two sites in this packet are new; the remaining 32 are listed but not individually analysed.

readers_negative_evidence.note: The map serializer 0x6097630 (#4337) and the apply loop 0x609c8c0 (#4334) walk the same vector but read only element+0x20 (base) and element+0x28 (map); neither reads the element name at +0x00..+0x18. Slot 12's rcx string comes from the literal 0x4376fd (#4328), not from an element. Which code reads the group name at runtime is an open unknown.

resolves: #3257 open unknown, for these two sites: the keys and fields of the RegisterOptions call sites in DBOptionsConfigurable
#4337 open unknown, for the DBOptions object: the 0x30-byte element's +0x00..+0x18 fields are a std::string name, and the element is a Configurable::RegisterOptions group record
open_unknowns: The keys and fields of the other 32 RegisterOptions call sites (listed in callers.tsv, not individually analysed).
Which code reads the element name string (+0x00..+0x18) at runtime; the serializer and apply loop read only +0x20/+0x28.
Why DBOptionsConfigurable overwrites its vtable pointer (0x64d3638 -> 0x64d36b8) between the two registrations.
The internals of the adjacent ctor calls in 0x60a47f0 (0x60a43c0 at object+0x98, 0x5d38750 at object+0x2d8, 0x60a3b60); only their arg registers are recorded here.
The contents of the .bss maps at 0x6506dc0 / 0x6506d80 beyond their entry counts from #4237 (file-unbacked; only addresses are pinned).
